Energy/oil just spiked sharply and precious metals/mining ran hot, arguing against fresh continuation entries at extended levels. Overall few high-conviction non-SPY overreaction cases; benchmark exposure dominates.
portfolio_rationale: Only two candidates clear both the overreaction label and the 55% bar: SMALL_CAP and SMALL_VALUE, both consolidating at 52-week highs after positive prior relative trends, with low volume and clear in-window catalysts (Sept 4 payrolls, Sept 16 FOMC and SEP) that can favor domestic small caps if rate-cut odds rebuild. Extended commodity, precious-metals and mining moves are treated as continuation without independent support and are not eligible. Duration, crypto, solar and Brazil show fundamental deterioration rather than temporary dislocation. Remaining exposure defaults to SPY, which is appropriate given a mixed macro tape at all-time highs.
